<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template for the carbonyl‑ene reaction. The forward reaction breaks a ketone (C=O) and a C‑C double bond, and forms a new C‑C bond and a C‑O bond, creating an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring. I will search the template catalog with these functional group and bond change criteria, using a compact JSON payload.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]","functional_groups_broken":["ketones","C-C double bonds"],"functional_groups_formed":["aliphatic hydroxyls","five-membered rings"],"bonds_formed":["C-C","C-O"],"bonds_broken":["C=C","C=O"],"limit":10}</action_input>
